attempts.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 (Alpine): unloaded it live, added /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/true), and discovered/removed usb-storage from the kernel cmdline force-load list (the modules= setting in /etc/update-extlinux.conf, regenerated via update-extlinux), since that mechanism bypassed the modprobe blacklist during initramfs. Verified across two full node restarts that usb_storage never loads and explicit modprobe attempts are no-ops. Completed the mandatory boot-identity restart protocol for node1.
